name: Ticket PR
description: Stems from Ticket Work and turns the session into an autonomous sentry over the ticket's pull request — resolves PR comments, commits and pushes fixes, and reports the status of what remains, with almost no operator interaction. When the operator explicitly hands it a list of their own ticket keys, one run can work several of them in sequence, switching branches between tickets and never touching a branch no queued ticket owns.

pullOnStart.label: Pull On Start
pullOnStart.description: When on, TPM auto-pulls the ticket from Jira at session start via Atlassian Suite. When off, the ticket description must be supplied manually and end-of-run status is reported as UNKNOWN. The ticket key is always derived from the branch name either way.

crossTicketStrictness.label: Cross Ticket Strictness
crossTicketStrictness.description: How TPM responds to references to work outside the active ticket. ask (default): confirm before treating it as in-scope. hard-block: refuse until this mode is disabled. soft-warn: warn once and proceed.

notesSections.label: Notes Sections
notesSections.description: Comma-separated top-level sections for the per-ticket notes file, in write order. Session Handoff's content is written by tool.session-handoff; section structure and templates come from tool.obsidian-notes — this list only selects and orders sections.
notesSections.default: Ticket Summary, Implementation Notes, Changes Made, Edge Cases, Testing Procedures, QA Findings, Session Handoff

offerPrCreationWhenAbsent.label: Offer PR Creation When Absent
offerPrCreationWhenAbsent.description: When on and the ticket's branch has no open PR, the sentry offers to create one via the pre-PR checklist and Atlassian Suite's create-pr verb; operator approval is still required and never waived. When off, it reports no PR to watch and stops.

autoResolveBotThreads.label: Auto Resolve Bot Threads
autoResolveBotThreads.description: When on, the sentry resolves bot-authored threads (CodeRabbit, etc.) automatically once the fix is pushed. When off, every resolve waits for operator ok. Human-authored threads are never auto-resolved either way.

autoCommitAndPush.label: Auto Commit And Push
autoCommitAndPush.description: When on, the sentry commits and pushes each verified fix to the ticket's branch without asking per change. Doesn't grant the git commands themselves — tool.git's allowlist governs those, and pushes to protected branches stay refused.

maxAutonomousIterations.label: Max Autonomous Iterations
maxAutonomousIterations.description: PER-TICKET cap on fetch/fix/push/resolve/re-review passes before the sentry stops and reports. A queued run also caps at this value times Max Tickets Per Run, so no ticket can starve the rest. Raise for long review cycles, lower to keep unattended runs short.

maxTicketsPerRun.label: Max Tickets Per Run
maxTicketsPerRun.description: Cap on tickets worked per run from an operator-supplied queue (an explicit key list — never a board/column query). Excess keys are dropped and reported before starting. Set to 1 for single-ticket sessions.

reviewStatusNames.label: Review Status Names
reviewStatusNames.description: Comma-separated allowlist of Jira status names counting as "in review" — exact match only, never a synonym or inferred equivalent. Used to offer the post-PR move (operator-confirmed, never automatic) and to check if the ticket is already in review. Replace with your board's actual column names.
reviewStatusNames.default: In Review, Code Review, Peer Review

statusReportVerbosity.label: Status Report Verbosity
statusReportVerbosity.description: How much detail the status roll-up carries. summary (default): counts plus anything failed, blocked, unverified, or flagged. detailed: also lists every thread by ordinal, author, and disposition.
